tags.name: api
tags.description: «Recursos Humanos» over OCS: API v1, the one its own pages read and outside systems use (recursos-humanos#1, API contract). v1 only grows; a change that would break callers ships as v2 beside it. Consumers send `OCS-APIRequest: true`, which is also the CSRF protection, and get the OCS envelope back; a session or a Nextcloud app password signs them in. Every route is attribute-routed, open to any signed-in person and rate-limited (MetadataTest holds all three); who may see what is checked inside each action, through Access. A refusal answers aps-common's client error shape, `{message}`, with the Spanish reason the screens show.
